title: Rubio Urges Europe to Awaken From ‘Slumber’ and Uphold Western Dominance
summary_full: In Greece, Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Western nations must embrace an earlier ethos of exploration and conquest as part of their civilization, to remain ‘at the head of the world.’
